title: Grateful Dead Live at Sandstone Ampitheatre on 1991-06-24
lineage: Dat (Sony R500)> Behringer UltraMatch SRC2000> SEK'D Prodif Plus> Samplitude v7.02 Professional> SHN; Recorded By JC Mahoney, Dan O'Neill, with patch source by Ed Boardman; Transferred By Charlie Miller
taper: JC Mahoney, Dan O'Neill, with patch source by Ed Boardman
source: FOB AKG C460B/CK61 (ORTF)> Mike Grace Early Preamp> Dat Master (Casio DA-7/48k)

ai_review.summary: Crisp soundboard capture of a jam‑filled night highlighted by a smoking Help > Slipknot! > Franklin’s Tower sequence, fiery Franklin’s, and Jerry’s fierce vocals with rocking drums.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised for its crystal‑clear, “crispy” audio that lets the band’s late‑70s/early‑80s vibe shine through. The performance features a standout Help > Slipknot! > Franklin’s Tower run and a blazing Franklin’s, with Jerry Garcia delivering intense vocal delivery and searing guitar licks while the drums drive the set forward.

ai_rating.rationale: One glowing 5‑star review emphasizes both superb sound quality and exceptional musical moments, while a brief 3‑star comment is neutral; overall the show and recording merit a strong rating but limited data keeps confidence at medium.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the audio as crisp, clear and “crispy,” with no noted drop‑outs or mix issues.

standout_songs: Help on the Way > Slipknot! > Franklin's Tower
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is portrayed as a jam‑fest that encourages dancing, with seamless transitions and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Described as angrily belting lyrics and delivering instrumental‑level licks; he’s “on tonight.”
band_member_comments.Drums: The drums are noted as rocking and driving the performance.
